recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed unless future terminology governance changes or removes alt-home from the THO discharge-disposition CodeSystem.
issue_request: FHIR-12888 was Published/Persuasive for PA and requested adding an alternate-home discharge disposition concept for patients discharged home but not to the patient's own home. The accepted resolution specified code alt-home with display Alternative home and a family-member/caregiver-home definition.
initial_application: Git commit f4b6c9c7d8c20db1a1b04162e1f13143723c8935 lists GF#12888 among Encounter changes and added alt-home to the then-core codesystem-encounter-discharge-disposition.xml.
additional_context: Encounter is active in source/fhir.ini and Encounter.admission.dischargeDisposition binds to ValueSet/encounter-discharge-disposition. Current core source composes that ValueSet from http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/discharge-disposition, and the local hl7.terminology.r5 package contains alt-home with the requested definition. Release-history artifacts also show alt-home in R4 and R5 expansions. No later conflicting Jira, Zulip, or Confluence evidence was found.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No core source edit is needed because re-adding inline concepts would duplicate the external terminology source and would not change the current built specification.
